verdict.rationale: Jan's first-party README and docs state that it integrates MCP servers for agentic capabilities and can connect to MCP servers. Its MCP docs describe per-tool-call approval panels showing the exact arguments, which confirms the model invokes tools from connected servers. A first-party Browser MCP also shipped in v0.7.3. Missing for 10: documented steps for adding or configuring MCP servers (transports, config format), and independent or hands-on corroboration of third-party MCP servers working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Model Context Protocol: MCP integration for agentic capabilities
